change_note: R6 explicit-invocation qualification for the bundled Adaptive Experiment workflow.

cases.prompt: Use the Regenerative Adaptive Experiment skill to design the smallest responsible experiment for this idea: a 40-person software team suspects that protecting one 90-minute interruption-free focus block each morning could improve concentration, but it may harm collaboration, accessibility, response time, or workload distribution. Design a reversible test before any organization-wide rollout.
